import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from collections import Counter
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---------- conservation from Pfam full alignment ----------
txt = requests.get("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/interpro/wwwapi/entry/pfam/PF07433/?annotation=alignment:full", timeout=300).text
seqs={}
for line in txt.splitlines():
    if not line or line.startswith("#") or line.startswith("//"): continue
    n,a=line.split(None,1); seqs[n]=seqs.get(n,"")+a.strip()
M=np.array([list(s) for s in seqs.values()]); AAs="ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY"
qname=[k for k in seqs if k.startswith("Q88PE2")][0]; qrow=seqs[qname]
qstart=int(qname.split("/")[1].split("-")[0])
rows=[]; pos=qstart-1
for j in range(M.shape[1]):
    ch=qrow[j]
    if ch in "-.": continue
    pos+=1
    c=Counter(x.upper() for x in M[:,j] if x.upper() in AAs); n=sum(c.values())
    f=np.array([c.get(a,0)/n for a in AAs]); H=-(f[f>0]*np.log2(f[f>0])).sum()
    top,tn=c.most_common(1)[0]
    rows.append(dict(resnum=pos, aa=ch.upper(), cons=1-H/np.log2(20), top=top, topfrac=tn/n, occ=n/M.shape[0]))
C=pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("resnum")
C.to_csv("PP_0908_DUF1513_conservation.csv")

LIG=[67,114,163,224,361,164,359]
print("CONSERVATION OF THE PREDICTED POCKET LIGANDS (Pfam PF07433 full alignment, n=%d seqs)"%M.shape[0])
print(C.loc[LIG].assign(pct_identical=lambda d:(d.topfrac*100).round(1))[["aa","top","pct_identical","occ","cons"]].to_string())
print("\nAll His in mature PP_0908 and their family conservation:")
his=[i for i in C.index if C.loc[i,"aa"]=="H"]
print(C.loc[his].assign(pct=lambda d:(d.topfrac*100).round(1))[["aa","top","pct"]].to_string())
print("\nTotal His in full protein: %d ; His inside the Pfam domain: %d ; of these invariant (>99%%): %d"%(
    "".count("H"),
    len(his), sum(C.loc[i,"topfrac"]>0.99 for i in his)))

# ---------- figure ----------
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1, figsize=(13,7.5), gridspec_kw={"height_ratios":[2,1.1]})
ax=axes[0]
ax.bar(C.index, C.cons, width=1.0, color="#8c9bb0", linewidth=0)
for r in [67,114,163,224,361]:
    ax.bar([r],[C.loc[r,"cons"]], width=2.2, color="#c0392b")
    ax.annotate(f"H{r}", (r, 1.02), ha="center", fontsize=10, color="#c0392b", fontweight="bold")
for r,lab,col in [(359,"D359","#1f6f8b"),(164,"E164","#1f6f8b")]:
    ax.bar([r],[C.loc[r,"cons"]], width=2.2, color=col)
    ax.annotate(lab,(r,C.loc[r,"cons"]+0.03), ha="center", fontsize=9, color=col)
ax.set_ylim(0,1.15); ax.set_xlim(55,370)
ax.set_ylabel("conservation (1 - normalised entropy)")
ax.set_xlabel("PP_0908 residue number")
ax.set_title("DUF1513 (PF07433, 2078 sequences): five invariant histidines in PP_0908", loc="left")

ax=axes[1]
pairs=[(67,114,3.4),(67,163,4.8),(67,224,4.6),(67,361,3.3),(114,163,3.5),(114,224,3.6),
       (114,361,3.8),(163,224,4.0),(163,361,6.3),(224,361,3.6)]
lbl=[f"H{a}-H{b}" for a,b,_ in pairs]; val=[d for _,_,d in pairs]
cols=["#c0392b" if v<5 else "#e8a33d" for v in val]
ax.bar(lbl,val,color=cols); ax.axhline(4.2,ls="--",c="k",lw=1)
ax.annotate("4.2 A: upper bound for two ligands\ntrans across one metal ion", (0.55,0.72), xycoords="axes fraction", fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("min N(imidazole)-N distance (A)")
ax.set_title("Imidazole nitrogens of the five invariant His are mutually within 3.3-6.3 A", loc="left", fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
